No-build audit of torch.linalg.qr / torch.linalg.householder_product substitution from naive f00391a. Feasible only in a roundabout way: torch.linalg.qr(A) gives explicit Q,R, not compact H,tau; householder_product is one-way H,tau -> Q, so it cannot invert Q into reflectors. To satisfy the contract one would need geqrf(Q) and replace upper(Hq) with Rh@R, making Qh^T A = Rh R. This is correct in principle but strictly adds explicit-Q materialization, a second QR, and a GEMM beyond torch.geqrf. No active shape benefits; exact tau=0 returns apply only upper/diagonal families, not ranked active shapes.

Brief 18 complete from naive main f00391a with no edits/builds/validation/benchmarks/profiles/submissions. torch.linalg.qr cannot directly replace torch.geqrf because the task requires compact Householder H,tau, while torch.linalg.qr returns explicit Q,R. torch.linalg.householder_product only maps compact factors to Q and provides no inverse. The only generic composition is torch.linalg.qr(A) -> geqrf(Q) -> set upper(H)=Rh@R, which is feasible but slower than geqrf due explicit Q, second QR, and GEMM. It offers no cherry-pick potential; optimized branch already uses custom compact-Householder/CholeskyQR reconstruction where explicit-Q paths make sense.
